get.description: PUBLIC — intentionally unauthenticated, like the /uploads static route it replaces: browser tags cannot send an Authorization header, and avatars carry no per-viewer access restriction (ADR-033).

Returns overall service status, database connectivity, and (011-system-logs) Loki reachability. Returns 200 when healthy, 503 when the database is unreachable. A Loki outage is reported (loki=error) but does NOT flip the overall status to 503 — the application continues operating normally without it (FR-012, best-effort logging).

username.description:
Username is never writable; the field exists so a request that tries is
refused (400) instead of being silently ignored.

locked.description:
Locked is true when the task belongs to a completed sprint. The board shows such a
card with a lock and does not let it be dragged (the task page is unchanged).

is_active.description: IsActive is false for a deactivated account; the mention suggestions leave those out.

username.description:
Username is optional; when empty one is generated from the email.
Validated by the service (rules, reserved names, uniqueness).

demo_banner_enabled.description:
DemoBannerEnabled is "true"/"false" as a string, same reason as above
(013-demo-instance-banner, FR-001).

system_log_retention_days.description:
SystemLogRetentionDays is a string (not an int) for the same reason
every other setting value is a string: global_settings is a generic
key-value store (011-system-logs, FR-010).

add_user_id.description:
AddUserID is non-zero when the team member created in step 2
should be added to this project as a "member".

demo_banner_enabled.description:
DemoBannerEnabled/DemoBannerMessage let unauthenticated pages (e.g.
/login) show the demo-instance banner without needing the JWT-gated
GET /settings (013-demo-instance-banner, research.md Decision 1).

assignee_id.description: AssigneeID assigns the issue to a user. Send 0 to unassign; omit to leave unchanged.

sprint_id.description: SprintID assigns the issue to a sprint. Send 0 to move the issue back to the backlog.

username.description:
Username cannot be changed; the field exists only so a request that tries
is refused instead of silently ignored. The current value is accepted.

committed.description: total story points across all sprint issues
